searchText: <@!301186049323958275> discussion resume > is [there] a world where supply is large enough for any demand? In theory, yes. Practically no. There is likely always going to be a supply constraint that limits usage to those most willing to pay to use the system. Just like with some goods in a traditional market, technological advances may be able to reach high enough levels of supply that most people are willing to pay the cost to use the system.
